name: focus-modes
title: Focus Modes
description: Switch between your macOS Focus modes, like Do Not Disturb, Work, or Sleep, right from Raycast.
author: kikks

commands.name: set-focus-mode
commands.title: Set Focus Mode
commands.description: See your Focus modes, turn one on, or turn off the current one.

commands.name: turn-on-focus
commands.title: Turn On Focus
commands.description: Turn on a Focus mode by typing its name.

commands.name: turn-off-focus
commands.title: Turn Off Focus
commands.description: Turn off whichever Focus mode is on.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
